support-mailbox-live.what: The support mailbox shown on /support exists and a test message to it arrives (the owner's mailbox step). Until then /support is a draft: a page with an address that bounces would mislead people.

privacy-text-approved.what: The privacy policy's final text is approved by the owner, and every claim in it matches what the app enforces today.

terms-text-approved.what: The terms of use are approved by the owner. Needed once Plus (the subscription) ships.

ios-store-live.what: Piggybow is public on the App Store, its product page URL is set here, and src/assets/badges/app-store.svg is Apple's official badge artwork, unmodified.

android-store-live.what: Piggybow is public on Google Play (production), and src/assets/badges/google-play.svg is Google's official badge artwork, unmodified.
